[NERR.8.2] **A failed load spends the engine** ([RDSC.9.8]), and whether
another load can succeed is the code's to say. A load that has begun reading the
artefact fails with one of these:

- **The artefact itself.** Every code in [NERR.8.1] and [RDSC.11.1];
  `DS_ERR_BND_INCOMPLETE`, for a `dialect_def_sha256` that is not 32 bytes
  ([RDSC.3.7]); and `DS_ERR_FN_NOT_FOUND`, for a call naming an op this runtime
  has no handler for where it stands ([RDSC.4a.9.3]). Every engine of this build
  refuses the same bytes the same way, so another load needs a corrected
  artefact, or, for `DS_ERR_DSC_CAPABILITY_ABSENT` and `DS_ERR_FN_NOT_FOUND`, a
  build that has what the artefact needs.
- **The engine's policy.** `DS_ERR_BND_DIALECT_MISMATCH`, when the admission
  policy does not admit one of the artefact's settings ([NLFC.10.2]). An engine
  with another policy can load the same bytes.
- **Neither.** `DS_ERR_OOM`.

Any further load takes an engine of its own.
